name: Cazorla (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the arms of Cazorla (a tower beneath a star on dark red within an ornate white cartouche).
history: Municipal flag of Cazorla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
